recent_calls.summary: Tiffany called to report that her air conditioning, which was recently repaired, has broken down again and she is experiencing extreme heat inside her home. The agent documented the urgent situation and informed Tiffany that a technician will be dispatched on the next business day since it was after hours. Tiffany declined further assistance and the call ended with a promise of follow-up.

They preferred the appointment to be scheduled on Monday or Tuesday, with any time being acceptable. The agent confirmed the details and informed the user that the team would confirm availability on the next business day.

The agent confirmed service availability but explained that exact scheduling could not be done after hours and offered to take details for follow-up on the next business day.
